threat_event: Malicious script loaded through the shared tag management service skims card data on payment pages of more than one division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One tag container serves all three divisions; "all pages" containers bypass payment page change approval; tamper detection only on the retail web checkout; alerts reviewed weekly; Rewards Card field outside hosted fields
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4 tag management; retail checkout; wholesale portal payment page
existing_controls: Hosted payment fields; script inventory for the retail web checkout; WAF; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Payment-pages-only tag container with approval by each page owner; tamper detection on all four payment pages with alerts to the SOC; isolated Rewards Card frame

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and stops stores, distribution centers, and card servicing at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, WAN, and data centers connect all divisions; acquired stores and distribution center OT less segmented
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups; active-active payment switch
treatment_plan: Finish acquired store and OT segmentation; full-volume WMS restore test; cross-division ransomware tabletop

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses an acquirer, FTC, state, customer, or SEC deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix lacks the FTC Safeguards notice, Reg Z handling, and wholesale customer terms; never exercised across divisions
regulatory_driver: N44-45-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(j)); N44-45-R01 (merchant agreement 24-hour notice); Fla. Stat. 501.171; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI in pricing, credit, and loss prevention harms customers or breaks consumer finance and consumer protection law
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI Standard adopted after the pricing engine and credit model were live; credit reason codes not revalidated after retraining; fairness testing partial
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 pricing engine; SYS-D6 credit decision engine; self-checkout analytics
existing_controls: Model risk committee for credit; pricing bounds; no facial recognition
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): council approval of High-tier uses, reason code validation, fairness tests, emergency price freeze

threat_event: Division staff follow outdated standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Financial Services standards last aligned in 2024; supplement has no named owner
existing_controls: Group policies v2026; Group CISO policy office
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Financial Services supplement; annual alignment attestation

threat_event: Divisions cannot show which safeguards group common controls provide
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented only for the EPP; not for the wholesale portal or the card and lending platform
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrices for SYS-D5 and SYS-D6, confirmed each year

threat_event: An administrator's workforce identity is phished and used across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote workforce still partly on number-matching MFA, not phishing-resistant
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; risk-based sign-in
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for all remote access by 2027-06-30

threat_event: A critical third party (processor, card processing platform, tag or script vendor) has an outage or breach affecting several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tag and script vendors not on the TPSP list; card platform reviewed by SOC 1 only; three expired AOCs
affected_asset_or_process: Payment processor; card processing platform; SYS-G4 vendors
existing_controls: Contracts with security terms; AOC collection for most TPSPs
treatment_plan: Complete the TPSP list and responsibility matrix; Safeguards-based review of the card platform; vendor exit plans

threat_event: Rewards Card data is used for marketing contrary to cardholder opt-outs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 41,000 affiliate marketing opt-outs not passed to the CDP; exception analysis not documented
existing_controls: Intercompany data agreement; annual privacy notice with opt-out
treatment_plan: Opt-out feed to the CDP with daily suppression; documented exception rules

threat_event: Weaknesses brought in with the 2025 acquisition expose card data before migration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 46 stores on legacy POS with flat networks, vendor remote tool, password-only back office, late patches; stray card numbers in acquired settlement exports
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 acquired stores; SYS-G5 finance file share
existing_controls: Store firewalls at the acquired stores; EDR on controllers
treatment_plan: Segment, test, and monitor the 46 stores before ROC fieldwork closes; delete stray card numbers; migrate by 2027-06-30

threat_event: An SEC filing misstates the group's cybersecurity governance or a material incident is filed late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee relies on division facts that arrive at different speeds
treatment_plan: Materiality step in the P08 runbook; annual Item 106 review by internal audit

threat_event: An intrusion goes unseen because some systems do not send logs to the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Acquired store controllers, the legacy store gateway, and distribution center OT not onboarded

threat_event: Attackers move between OT and IT networks at distribution centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weak OT segmentation; always-on OT vendor access; no OT inventory at 2 sites
existing_controls: EDR on WMS servers; firewalls at the 2 newest sites
treatment_plan: OT segmentation and inventory; vendor access through PAM
owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

threat_event: A workforce member misuses customer or cardholder data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad CDP query roles; call center agents see full account data
existing_controls: Role-based access; quarterly certification; sanctions policy
treatment_plan: Purpose-based CDP roles; call center screen masking

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes a division data store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many division accounts; guardrails cover most but not all services
treatment_plan: Extend guardrails to the remaining managed services

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida stores, distribution centers, and the primary data center at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 214 stores, 3 distribution centers, and the primary data center are in Florida
existing_controls: Active-active switch; secondary data center outside Florida; generators
treatment_plan: Joint hurricane exercise across divisions each May
